approvalText: 다 저장해두고 써라 저런게 더 좋지 이전거는 이상해

usageRules: Use this whole board or the identified region as the design identity reference in subsequent image work.
Three designs are all approved; none is discarded or silently assigned an item tier or skill.
Old plain circular-disc-on-shaft appearance is superseded and must not be used as current style authority.
Geometry-only straight-spear guides remain usable for rigid axis alignment; do not confuse them with approved appearance.
Keep rigid metal axes and approved fixed curves, use the common negative prompt, reject warped output.
Top tip framing, full assembly alignment, hand grips and final production/runtime preparation remain separate technical work.
limitations: Variant ids are reference-library keys, not gameplay item/skill ids.
sourceRegion entries identify columns on the unmodified original board; no independent cropped PNGs or transparent runtime textures were produced.
Visual approval does not certify the original board's tight upper margins or all geometric checks.
